name: Navigation / Mobile Product Navigation
description: Mobile Product Navigation product scenario for the Navigation component.

controls.name: items
controls.description: The bar's items in order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Value of the current page's item, marked `aria-current="page"`; `null` marks none, and an unknown value marks none.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Current item on mount when `value` is not set; read once.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: `inline` shows the bar; `sheet` shows a trigger that opens the items in a bottom sheet; `auto` is a sheet below 900px.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Whether the sheet is open; only a sheet surface opens, and leaving it closes an uncontrolled sheet.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Whether the sheet is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: trigger
controls.description: Element that opens the sheet, keeping its own props; text renders as a Button. Default: an icon button named `labels.open`.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the navigation landmark and titles the sheet; an untitled sheet is named by its trigger.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Navigation renders itself: `open` names the default sheet trigger, `close` the sheet's close button.
